spec.title: AC Power
spec.description: Combined AC input power across all Rectifier Units.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "kW" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_combined_ac_power_all_units') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: DC Power
spec.description: Combined DC output power across all Rectifier Units.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "kW" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_combined_dc_power_all_units') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: Efficiency
spec.description: Combined AC-to-DC conversion efficiency across all Rectifier Units.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "%" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_conversion_efficiency_all_units') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: DC Voltage
spec.description: Average DC output voltage across all Rectifier Units.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "V" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_average_dc_voltage_all_units') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: DC Current
spec.description: Combined DC output current across all Rectifier Units.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "A" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_combined_dc_current_all_units') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: DC Current Limits
spec.description: Requested, effective, thermal and applied DC current limits.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "Requested" FROM "A" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_set_dc_current_limit') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("value") AS "Effective" FROM "A" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_effective_dc_current_limit') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("value") AS "Thermal" FROM "A" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_thermal_dc_current_limit') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("value") AS "Applied" FROM "A" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_applied_dc_current_limit') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: Rectifier DC Power
spec.description: DC output power of Rectifier Units 1-3.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "Unit 1" FROM "W" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_dc_power_unit_1') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("value") AS "Unit 2" FROM "W" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_dc_power_unit_2') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("value") AS "Unit 3" FROM "W" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_dc_power_unit_3') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: Rectifier DC Current
spec.description: DC output current of Rectifier Units 1-3.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "Unit 1" FROM "A" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_dc_current_unit_1') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("value") AS "Unit 2" FROM "A" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_dc_current_unit_2') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("value") AS "Unit 3" FROM "A" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_dc_current_unit_3') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: Rectifier Output Temperature
spec.description: Output temperature of Rectifier Units 1-3.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "Unit 1" FROM "°C" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_output_temperature_unit_1') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("value") AS "Unit 2" FROM "°C" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_output_temperature_unit_2') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("value") AS "Unit 3" FROM "°C" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_output_temperature_unit_3') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: Enclosure Temperature
spec.description: Rear Rectifier compartment temperature.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "°C" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_rectifier_compartment_temperature') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: Enclosure Humidity
spec.description: Rear Rectifier compartment relative humidity.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "%" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_rectifier_compartment_humidity') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: Cooling Fan PWM
spec.description: Actual EMC2101 enclosure cooling PWM duty-cycle readback.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "%" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_cooling_fan_pwm_actual') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: Cooling Fan RPM
spec.description: External enclosure Cooling Fan 1-3 speed.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "Fan 1" FROM "RPM" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_cooling_fan_1_rpm') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("value") AS "Fan 2" FROM "RPM" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_cooling_fan_2_rpm') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("value") AS "Fan 3" FROM "RPM" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_cooling_fan_3_rpm') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: Cooling Fan Controller Temperature
spec.description: EMC2101 internal controller temperature.

spec.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "°C" WHERE ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_cooling_fan_controller_temperature') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

spec.title: Available Units
spec.description: Last known number of CAN-reachable Rectifier Units.

spec.query: SELECT last("value") AS "Available" FROM "state" WHERE ("domain"::tag = 'sensor') AND ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_available_units')

spec.title: Running Units
spec.description: Last known number of CAN-reachable Rectifier Units explicitly reporting ON.

spec.query: SELECT last("value") AS "Running" FROM "state" WHERE ("domain"::tag = 'sensor') AND ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_running_units')

spec.title: CAN Unit 1
spec.description: Last known CAN connectivity state for Rectifier Unit 1.

spec.query: SELECT last("value") AS "Unit 1" FROM "state" WHERE ("domain"::tag = 'binary_sensor') AND ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_can_communication_unit_1')

spec.title: CAN Unit 2
spec.description: Last known CAN connectivity state for Rectifier Unit 2.

spec.query: SELECT last("value") AS "Unit 2" FROM "state" WHERE ("domain"::tag = 'binary_sensor') AND ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_can_communication_unit_2')

spec.title: CAN Unit 3
spec.description: Last known CAN connectivity state for Rectifier Unit 3.

spec.query: SELECT last("value") AS "Unit 3" FROM "state" WHERE ("domain"::tag = 'binary_sensor') AND ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_can_communication_unit_3')

spec.title: Rectifier CAN Connectivity History
spec.description: CAN connectivity state changes for Rectifier Units 1-3 within the selected time range.

spec.query: SELECT "value" AS "Unit 1" FROM "state" WHERE ("domain"::tag = 'binary_sensor') AND ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_can_communication_unit_1') AND $timeFilter
SELECT "value" AS "Unit 2" FROM "state" WHERE ("domain"::tag = 'binary_sensor') AND ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_can_communication_unit_2') AND $timeFilter
SELECT "value" AS "Unit 3" FROM "state" WHERE ("domain"::tag = 'binary_sensor') AND ("entity_id"::tag = '${instance}_can_communication_unit_3') AND $timeFilter
